name: Sunrise Group Company Limited
summary: Sunrise Group Company Limited engages in the research and development, design, production, and sales of food and beverage packaging containers in China. The company offers beverage cans and food cans, including three-piece cans, two-piece cans, aluminum bottles, and metal packaging products. It also engages in the beverage filling, appearance packaging design, and logistics support business, as well as research and development, design, printing, production, distribution, filling, and information intelligent data services. In addition, the company leases land and property. Further, it provides supply chain management services; QR code canning services; easy-open lids; bottle caps; color print…
